processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Common upstream step for the studied LDS grades (before hot rolling).
Final thickness of hot rolled plate ~13 mm; details reported elsewhere [21].

processing_steps.reduction_ratio: ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 15Mn5Ni alloy experienced cracking beyond 50% cold reduction; further reduction not carried out on any alloy for comparison. Samples denoted HR+CR. Cold rolling restricted to 50% to avoid severe shear banding (>50%).

processing_steps.method: heat treatment (annealing) followed by water quenching
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Heat treatment in the two-phase region; at 1173 K complete dissolution of κ-carbides and partial dissolution of B2 occurred, giving partial recrystallization of austenite.

structures.overall_structure: Partially recrystallized austenitic (γ, FCC) matrix with mixed recrystallized and deformed austenite together with retained prior B2 stringers and secondary B2 precipitates; κ-carbides completely dissolved after heat treatment at 1173 K. XRD shows peaks of both γ and B2 and no κ-carbide peaks.

phases_present.morphology: finer recrystallized coloured grains with black B2 stringer bands

microstructure_list.region: stringer bands (aligned along RD) and grain boundaries

phases_present.phase_name: B2 (FeAl-based ordered phase containing significant Mn and Ni)
phases_present.morphology: prior B2 stringers fully recovered into bamboo-type grain morphology; fine intragranular and coarser intergranular B2 precipitates; blue B2 features markedly fewer and thinner at 1173 K than at 973 K

phase_interfaces.coherence: New B2 precipitates formed at 1173 K showed single crystal type orientations but displayed some orientation relationship with the adjacent γ-grains.

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: In 15Mn5Ni HR+CR+1173 K deformed to ε~0.02, individual dislocations bow, loop and tangle around elongated B2 particles; non-shearable B2 particles act as obstacles to dislocation motion, leading to early initiation of slip band refinement.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip activity followed by dynamic slip band refinement with applied strain; inhomogeneous slip band spacing developed in Ni-containing LDS alloys; dislocation-B2 particle interaction and dislocation-annealing twin interaction in the recrystallized austenite.
interfaces.phase_evolution: With increase in heat treatment temperature to 1173 K, κ-carbides completely dissolved and B2 partially dissolved, causing a sudden rise in the recrystallization fraction of austenite; B2 volume fraction decreased drastically from ~40% (973 K) to ~15% (1173 K). Prior B2 stringers fully recovered into bamboo-type grain morphology.
interfaces.interface_notes: Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along γ/γ boundaries and γ/B2 interfaces; intragranular B2 particles do not pin the newly recrystallized grains but may delay the overall recovery process.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimens, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4-5 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1; tests triplicated and average of three readings reported

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress-strain (Fig. 9b) and true stress-strain (Fig. 9c) curves reported; 15Mn5Ni-1173 K regains ductility and shows comparable stress-strain behaviour to 28Mn5Ni.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: strength-ductility levels and strain hardening characteristics

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-SEM equipped with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors (Oxford); TSL-OIM software
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Step size 120 nm (fine-grained) and 250 nm (coarse-grained) over ~100×100 μm² and ~200×200 μm² areas; three scans per sample; samples polished to colloidal silica ~100 nm finish
characterization_methods.purpose: Grain orientations, grain size, twin fractions, KAM (strain localization), GOS 2° criterion (recrystallized fraction), phase identification
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni at 1173 K shows recrystallization fraction ~0.4-0.5, recrystallized grain size few μm, twin fraction ~0.2, and B2 volume fraction ~15%; retained prior B2 stringers and secondary B2 present.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku XRD instrument with Co-Kα radiation
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: 45 kV and 135 mA; beam size ~2 mm; 2θ range ~40-120°
characterization_methods.purpose: Phase identification in cold rolled and heat-treated conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni HR+CR+1173 K shows peaks of both γ and B2 phases and no noticeable κ-carbide peaks.

characterization_methods.technique: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) with SAED and EDS
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 operating at 200 kV equipped with EDAX EDS; twin-jet electropolished specimens (mixed acid at 243 K)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Bright-field and dark-field imaging; dark-field captured from (010)κ satellite spot; SAED patterns
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify phases (κ-carbide, B2), particle sizes/morphology and B2 composition
characterization_methods.key_findings: At 1173 K in 15Mn5Ni, κ-carbides fully dissolved and only intragranular B2 particles remain; prior B2 stringers recovered into bamboo-type morphology.

characterization_methods.purpose: Examine fracture surfaces and crack propagation
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni heat treated at 1023 K failed by quasi-cleavage/crack-initiation-controlled fracture along γ/B2 interphase boundaries; at 1173 K ductility was regained.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s, as per ASTM E-140-02; average of ten measurements per sample
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure bulk hardness variation with cold work and heat treatment
characterization_methods.key_findings: Ni-containing alloys (28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni) softened monotonically with heat treatment temperature; hardness at 873 K raised Ni-containing alloys to ~500 VHN.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Room temperature; cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1 (initial strain rate ~3×10^-4 s^-1); flat specimens (gauge 30 mm × 6 mm × 4-5 mm); ASTM E8M; triplicated
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate strength and ductility of processed alloys
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni HR+CR+1173 K gave YS 971±5 MPa, UTS 1303±12 MPa, TE 36±1%, n=0.30; brittle at 973 K and 1023 K.

unmapped_findings: For the 15Mn5Ni alloy the thermo-mechanical processing (heat treatment) temperature window was found to be around 1173 K, which yields the optimum combination of strength and ductility.

In 15Mn5Ni, increasing the heat treatment temperature from 973 K to 1173 K decreased the total B2 volume fraction drastically from ~40% to ~15%; the dissolution rate of fine intragranular and intergranular B2 was higher than that of the B2 stringers (the total B2 fraction comprises stringer, intragranular and intergranular types).

No noticeable growth of recrystallized austenite grains occurred in the Ni-containing LDS alloys (including 15Mn5Ni) up to 1173 K, in contrast to significant grain growth in the B2-free 28Mn0Ni alloy.

At 973 K and 1023 K, the 15Mn5Ni alloy behaved in a brittle manner with tensile elongation <1% and its stress-strain curves could not be recorded; at 973 K and 1023 K the tensile properties of 15Mn5Ni are not available.

In 15Mn5Ni specifically, the higher volume fraction of B2 (including prior B2 stringers) and co-precipitation of coarser κ-carbides and B2 along grain boundaries at 973 K and 1023 K was detrimental; complete dissolution of κ-carbides and partial dissolution of B2 at 1173 K caused a sudden rise in the recrystallization fraction of austenite grains.

TEM-EDS B2 composition for 15Mn5Ni at 1173 K: Particle-1 Mn 10.5 wt.% (9.5 at.%), Al 12.8 wt.% (23.5 at.%), Ni 20.2 wt.% (17.0 at.%), Fe balance; Particle-2 Mn 8.7 wt.% (7.8 at.%), Al 13.5 wt.% (24.6 at.%), Ni 22.0 wt.% (18.5 at.%), Fe balance.
